tools.name: notes_search
tools.description: Search the user's notes by full-text query and return matching note IDs with titles. Use this to locate a note before reading it. Do not use it to read note bodies — call notes_read for that.

tools.name: notes_archive
tools.description: Move a note to the archive. The note remains retrievable and can be restored with notes_restore. Use when the user is finished with a note but may want it later.
